# HireStepX

> HireStepX is an AI mock interview platform for candidates in India. Upload a resume, pick a role, practise a spoken interview with an AI interviewer and get a scored report with feedback. Employers can also review candidates by their practice evidence and pay per unlock.

The first 2 practice sessions are free with no card. Pricing is in INR with UPI support and no subscription.

## Main pages

- [For candidates](https://hirestepx.com/candidates): practise interviews and get scored feedback
- [For employers](https://hirestepx.com/employers): hire from practice evidence, pay per unlock
- [Pricing](https://hirestepx.com/pricing): free sessions, session packs and employer unlocks
- [About](https://hirestepx.com/about)
- [Contact](https://hirestepx.com/contact)
